name: Explorer Plugin
description: Combined split-pane Explorer plugin compositing FileExplorerPlugin (left, default 260px, resizable 120-600px via drag handle) and MonacoEditorPlugin (right, fills remaining space). Bridges markdown openers from canvas to file explorer. Opens files in editor by clicking tree entries. Wraps Ctrl+P file search via CommandPalette. Synchronizes editor state (open files, active file, cursor positions, explorer width) for serialization and theme updates. Auto-hides editor panel when no tabs are open.

methods.name: openFileSearch
methods.description: Create CommandPalette if null, then open it

methods.name: updateTheme
methods.description: Forward theme update to Monaco editor

methods.name: restoreEditorState
methods.description: Restore explorer width and editor state

properties.name: onStateChange
properties.description: State change callback for save serialization

layout.split: Horizontal flex layout: FileExplorer (left, 260px default, 120-600px range) + 2px drag handle + MonacoEditor (right, flex:1)
layout.drag_handle: 2px col-resize cursor, highlights to --accent on hover/drag
layout.editor_hidden: display:none when editor has no tabs
